verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents domestic wires with a Wire Transfer object and status tracking, and has a dedicated FedNow page describing instant 24/7/365 settlement, so two of the three faster rails are covered by per-rail docs in the same API. RTP is never mentioned, and the evidence does not show whether wires and FedNow support both origination and receipt. Missing for 10: RTP support, explicit origination-and-receipt coverage per rail, detailed per-rail capability and limit documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
